requirements.title: Needs, desires, motives and practical objects
requirements.description: How embodied and socially produced needs are met/frustrated, and how activity transforms needs and gives motives an object.
requirements.question: What has to be present in actor history for an object to be possible or desired?

requirements.title: Thick, scoped expectations and early care
requirements.description: How reliable, insufficient or contradictory care organizes embodied and practical anticipation; repeat routine without requiring distinctive event memory.
requirements.question: What gives a baseline historical weight, scope, repair potential and rival expectation?

requirements.title: Challenge, complication, threat and repair
requirements.description: Actor-relative relations between a concrete encounter and a valued expectation, need or practical ability; objective and subjective danger separate.
requirements.question: When are challenge, complication and threat distinct and when do they coexist?

requirements.title: Simultaneous recruitment, tension and regulation
requirements.description: Multiple historically formed needs, concerns, interpretations and supports condition one another non-additively under a single situation.
requirements.question: Which operator recruits/blocks/reroutes what, and under what source-bearing conditions?

requirements.title: Durable transition, changed relations and contradiction
requirements.description: History-dependent acquisition, retention, differentiation, support-limited practice, loss, contradictory orientations and actual changes of causal links.
requirements.question: What warrants a new practical operation or changed relation rather than a large transient delta?

requirements.title: Interstitial activity, life-stages and social reproduction
requirements.description: Care, work, play, rest, school, practice, resource shifts and other people's ongoing actions between the event highlights.
requirements.question: What recurrent life can be computed without invented events or yearly learning multiplier?

requirements.title: Independent others, power, care and relational feedback
requirements.description: Two distinct constituted participants with actor-limited perceptions, objective relations of power/dependence and ongoing contingent responses.
requirements.question: How do independent intentions/actions and actual material relations alter the resolved encounter?

requirements.title: Differentiated impression, intensity, salience and no-change
requirements.description: How expected, novel, intense or disorienting acts form both affective and durable consequences, including not-memorable repetition and lawful no durable change.
requirements.question: What is the actor-specific impression and which components change for defensible reasons?

requirements.title: Actor's fallible autobiographical memory and meaning
requirements.description: Objective history versus impression, selectively accessible episode, reconstruction, self-account and newly causal internal reflection.
requirements.question: Why is this remembered, forgotten, misread or later reinterpreted?

requirements.title: Later ideology, theology and cosmological rearticulation
requirements.description: How preverbal felt care and scarcity are later mediated through actually accessible concepts, historical institutions, language and activity; no predetermined doctrine.
requirements.question: What new cultural operation becomes practically available and how does it recruit prior felt histories?

requirements.title: User-settled event-batch temporal recursion
requirements.description: LLM call N latter-half proposes 3–5 conditional events; Rawlsing sequentially resolves and develops; call N+1 first-half retrospectively narrates fallible memory/meaning.
requirements.question: How can next event consume actual earlier reorganization without an intermediate LLM call?

requirements.title: Actual C12 person, coupled world and human encounter
requirements.description: Actual historical person plus independently constituted others, legal Pyat world, issued rules and source, coupled user interaction and falsifiable changed later response.
requirements.question: Where is first current actual consumer, with native source/actor/owner grant and independent K-style negative?
